AND production_date BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate}
ORDER BY production_date DESC, inbound_id DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO inbound (inbound_id, production_date, package_unit_kg, package_count, size_um, outbound_qty, remark) VALUES (#{inboundId}, #{productionDate}, #{packageUnitKg}, #{packageCount}, #{sizeUm}, #{outboundQty}, #{remark})
mapper.update: UPDATE inbound SET production_date = #{productionDate}, package_unit_kg = #{packageUnitKg}, package_count = #{packageCount}, size_um = #{sizeUm}, remark = #{remark} WHERE inbound_id = #{inboundId}
mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(MAX(CAST(SUBSTRING(inbound_id FROM '\d+$') AS INTEGER)), 0) FROM inbound WHERE inbound_id LIKE CONCAT('P-', #{dateStr}, '-%')
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM inbound WHERE production_date = CURRENT_DATE

SELECT TO_CHAR(production_date, 'YYYY-MM') AS "month", COALESCE(SUM(package_count), 0)::INTEGER AS "qty" FROM inbound WHERE production_date >= DATE_TRUNC('month', CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '5 month') GROUP BY TO_CHAR(production_date, 'YYYY-MM') ORDER BY "month"

SELECT inbound_id AS "inboundId", (package_count - outbound_qty)::INTEGER AS "remaining" FROM inbound WHERE (package_count - outbound_qty) > 0 ORDER BY (package_count - outbound_qty) DESC, inbound_id LIMIT 10
